items.title: Nvidia’s Board Has No Plans to Bring Back Jensen Huang
items.summary: Despite pressure from President Trump, Elon Musk, and Silicon Valley executives, Nvidia’s board says it “does not intend” to reinstate the company’s ousted CEO.
items.author: Lauren Goode, Kate Taylor

items.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
items.summary: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: The Apple Watch’s Live Rewind Can Record and Rewind Spoken Conversations. It’s Pretty Awkward
items.summary: Live Rewind and Siri Recap can transcribe missed moments and summarize your day—if you don’t mind a little social clumsiness.
items.author: Julian Chokkattu

items.title: AI Told These Ex-Google Guys How to Build a Billion-Dollar Weapons Business
items.summary: Google and Apple alumni Chad Steelberg and Andy Baynes are applying what they learned running software companies and designing iPhones to manufacturing lethal munitions.
items.author: Isabella Ward
